        "kVK_RightArrow": UInt16(kVK_RightArrow),
    ]
    public static func resolve(_ mapping: KeyMapping) throws -> [UInt16: KeyMapping.Key] {
        var result: [UInt16: KeyMapping.Key] = [:]
        for key in mapping.keys {
            guard let code = codes[key.sdkConstantCandidate], result[code] == nil else {
                throw ProbeError.invalid("Unknown or repeated SDK key constant")
            }
            result[code] = key
        }
        return result
    }
}

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
code_root="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
project_root="$(cd "$code_root/.." && pwd)"
build_root="${TYPING_PIANO_BUILD_ROOT:-$HOME/Library/Caches/local.typingpiano.trial/candidate-0.2.5}"
mkdir -p "$build_root"
build_root="$(cd "$build_root" && pwd)"
if [ "$build_root" = "$HOME/Library/Caches/local.typingpiano.trial" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'Refusing to overwrite the authorized frozen trial. Use an independent candidate directory.' >&2
    exit 1
fi
scratch_path="$build_root/swiftpm"
# The checked-in original bank is verified below; building does not regenerate source assets.
python3 - "$code_root/Assets/placeholder-original.sf2" <<'PY'
import hashlib, pathlib, sys
p = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == "ded7747105075d3b5ed95fed7a0453f638dd27882b80defd1fcc7062c4c700fb"

swift build --build-system native --package-path "$code_root" --scratch-path "$scratch_path" -c release
binary_dir="$(swift build --build-system native --package-path "$code_root" --scratch-path "$scratch_path" -c release --show-bin-path)"

for trial in index['trials']:

folder = source / 'vcsl-steinway-b'
target = destination / folder.name
target.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for path in folder.iterdir():
    if path.is_file(): shutil.copy2(path, target / path.name)
shutil.copytree(folder / 'licenses', target / 'licenses', dirs_exist_ok=True)
record = {'sourceManifestSHA256': hashlib.sha256((folder/'audio.manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'excludedSourceDirectories': ['originals', 'samples'], 'note': 'Original source manifest retained for provenance. Original/intermediate WAVs remain in the project; runtime bank, parameters, licenses and source records are packaged.', 'files': []}
for path in sorted(destination.rglob('*')):

cat > "$app_path/Contents/Info.plist" <<'PLIST'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0"><dict>
<key>CFBundleExecutable</key><string>TypingPianoProbe</string>
<key>CFBundleIdentifier</key><string>local.typingpiano.trial</string>
<key>CFBundleName</key><string>打字钢琴试用</string>
<key>CFBundleVersion</key><string>8</string>
<key>CFBundleShortVersionString</key><string>0.2.5</string>
<key>TypingPianoSingleInstanceProtocol</key><integer>1</integer>
<key>CFBundlePackageType</key><string>APPL</string>
<key>LSMinimumSystemVersion</key><string>14.0</string>
<key>NSHighResolutionCapable</key><true/>
</dict></plist>
PLIST
# Only our reproducible generated bundle. Desktop file-provider FinderInfo can prevent ad-hoc signing.
# A file provider can add FinderInfo to a newly created signature directory.
# Retry only the generated-bundle signature, bounded; never change system preferences.
probe_signed=false
for attempt in 1 2 3; do
    xattr -cr "$app_path"
    if codesign --force --sign - "$app_path" && codesign --verify --strict "$app_path"; then
        probe_signed=true
        break
    fi
done
if [ "$probe_signed" != true ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'Local generated-bundle signing failed after 3 attempts.' >&2
    exit 1
fi
# Metadata-free local archive preserves signed bytes if the host later adds FinderInfo.
ditto --norsrc --noextattr --noacl -c -k --keepParent "$app_path" "$build_root/打字钢琴试用.zip"
printf '%s\n' "$app_path"

import XCTest
import AppKit
import PianoCore
import PianoAudio
@testable import PianoMac

final class TrialSessionTests: XCTestCase {
    func testContinuousSessionHasNoTimeoutButRetainsSafetyStops() {
        XCTAssertNil(InputSessionDuration.continuous.stopReason(elapsed: 86_400, secureInput: false, permissionValid: true))
        XCTAssertNotNil(InputSessionDuration.test60Seconds.stopReason(elapsed: 60, secureInput: false, permissionValid: true))
        XCTAssertNotNil(InputSessionDuration.continuous.stopReason(elapsed: 1, secureInput: true, permissionValid: true))
        XCTAssertNotNil(InputSessionDuration.continuous.stopReason(elapsed: 1, secureInput: false, permissionValid: false))
    }
    func testStartTrialEnablesAudioOverlayAndPauseFullyCleans() throws {
        _ = NSApplication.shared
        let root = URL(fileURLWithPath: #filePath).deletingLastPathComponent().deletingLastPathComponent().deletingLastPathComponent().deletingLastPathComponent()
        let input = ControllerIntegrationTests.Input(), engine = ControllerIntegrationTests.Engine()
        let preferences = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString).appendingPathComponent("preferences.json")
        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: preferences.deletingLastPathComponent()) }
        let controller = try ProbeController(mapping: KeyMapping.load(url: root.appendingPathComponent("contracts/keymap.ansi64.v0.1.json")), sources: AudioSource.available(root: root, bundled: false), preferencesURL: preferences, input: input, audioEngine: engine, installStatusItem: false)
        controller.applicationDidFinishLaunching(Notification(name: NSApplication.didFinishLaunchingNotification))
        defer { controller.applicationWillTerminate(Notification(name: NSApplication.willTerminateNotification)) }
        XCTAssertEqual(input.mode, .stopped); XCTAssertFalse(engine.prepared)
        controller.startTrial()
        XCTAssertEqual(input.mode, .global)
        XCTAssertEqual(input.duration, .continuous)
        XCTAssertTrue(engine.prepared); XCTAssertTrue(controller.integrationState.soundEnabled)
        input.onEvent?(.init("keyA", .down))
        XCTAssertEqual(controller.integrationState.floatingNotes, 1)
        controller.windowWillClose(Notification(name: NSWindow.willCloseNotification))
        XCTAssertEqual(input.mode, .global) // Closing a help/console window cannot end background work.
        input.onStop?("permission revoked")
        XCTAssertEqual(input.mode, .stopped); XCTAssertFalse(engine.prepared)
        XCTAssertFalse(controller.integrationState.soundEnabled)
        XCTAssertEqual(controller.integrationState.activeKeys, 0)
        XCTAssertEqual(controller.integrationState.floatingNotes, 0)
        input.fail = true
        controller.startTrial()
        XCTAssertEqual(input.mode, .stopped); XCTAssertFalse(engine.prepared)
        XCTAssertFalse(controller.integrationState.soundEnabled)
        input.fail = false; engine.failPrepare = true
        controller.startTrial()
        XCTAssertEqual(input.mode, .stopped); XCTAssertFalse(engine.prepared)
        XCTAssertEqual(controller.integrationState.activeKeys, 0)
    }
}
import XCTest
@testable import PianoCore

final class DockFadeTests: XCTestCase {
    func testUnknownStartsVisibleAndHiddenMustStabilizeBeforeRestore() {
        var fade = DockFade()
        fade.observe(.unknown, at: 0)
        XCTAssertEqual(fade.alpha(at: 0), 1)
        fade.observe(.visible, at: 0)
        XCTAssertTrue(fade.dockHidden)
        XCTAssertEqual(fade.alpha(at: 0.13), 0.5, accuracy: 0.00001)
        fade.observe(.hidden, at: 1)
        fade.observe(.hidden, at: 1.119)
        XCTAssertTrue(fade.dockHidden)
        fade.observe(.hidden, at: 1.121)
        XCTAssertFalse(fade.dockHidden)
        XCTAssertEqual(fade.alpha(at: 1.481), 1, accuracy: 0.00001)
    }
    func testUnknownCancelsPendingRestoreAndRepeatedSignalsDoNotRestart() {
        var fade = DockFade()
        fade.observe(.visible, at: 0)
        let generation = fade.generation
        fade.observe(.visible, at: 0.1)
        XCTAssertEqual(fade.generation, generation)
        fade.observe(.hidden, at: 1)
        fade.observe(.unknown, at: 1.1)
        fade.observe(.hidden, at: 1.2)
        XCTAssertTrue(fade.dockHidden)
        fade.observe(.hidden, at: 1.321)
        XCTAssertFalse(fade.dockHidden)
    }
    func testReversalIsContinuousAndUsesRemainingDistance() {
        var fade = DockFade()
        fade.observe(.visible, at: 0)
        fade.observe(.hidden, at: 0.001)
        let before = fade.alpha(at: 0.122)
        fade.observe(.hidden, at: 0.122)
        XCTAssertEqual(fade.alpha(at: 0.122), before, accuracy: 0.00001)
        let halfway = fade.alpha(at: 0.15)
        let generation = fade.generation
        fade.observe(.visible, at: 0.15)
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(fade.generation, generation)
        XCTAssertEqual(fade.alpha(at: 0.15), halfway, accuracy: 0.00001)
        XCTAssertEqual(fade.alpha(at: 0.15 + 0.26 * halfway + 0.0001), 0, accuracy: 0.00001)
    }
    func testSustainedUnknownRecoversAfterTwoSecondsWithoutRestartingTheFade() {
        var fade = DockFade()
        fade.observe(.visible, at: 0)
        fade.observe(.unknown, at: 1)
        fade.observe(.unknown, at: 2.99)
        XCTAssertTrue(fade.dockHidden)
        fade.observe(.unknown, at: 3)
        XCTAssertFalse(fade.dockHidden)
        let generation = fade.generation
        fade.observe(.unknown, at: 3.2)
        XCTAssertEqual(fade.generation, generation)
        XCTAssertEqual(fade.alpha(at: 3.36), 1, accuracy: 0.00001)
    }
    func testReducedMotionIsLinearAndRetargetsCurrentAlpha() {
        var fade = DockFade()
        fade.setReducedMotion(true, at: 0)
        fade.observe(.visible, at: 0)
        XCTAssertEqual(fade.alpha(at: 0.04), 0.5, accuracy: 0.00001)
        fade.setReducedMotion(false, at: 0.04)
        XCTAssertEqual(fade.alpha(at: 0.04), 0.5, accuracy: 0.00001)
        XCTAssertEqual(fade.alpha(at: 0.17), 0, accuracy: 0.00001)
    }
}

# 打字钢琴试用 0.2.5

当前版本为 **0.2.5 / build8**，Bundle ID 为 `local.typingpiano.trial`。默认使用全64音Steinway B试用音库，原生Quiet Ivory琴键、独立灰标签和700ms上升♪。Fn保留，顶部整排（包括Esc）排除。对外下载入口见[仓库根说明](../README.md)。

现成冻结包是 **Apple Silicon（arm64）** 构建，不是Universal包。源码以macOS14为编译目标，但实际仅在本机macOS27.2 arm64、Swift6.4验证；macOS14、其他系统版本和Intel源码构建均未完成兼容验收。包使用本地ad-hoc签名，未做Developer ID签名或公证，下载后的系统安全提示处理见根说明。

## 用户开始

1. 先选择固定、可写的目录放置App，再打开并授权。当前偏好与恢复票据写在App同级目录；不要来回移动已授权的App，也不要同时运行多个旧试用包。
2. 启动卡默认停止键盘监听和声音。点击“授权输入监控”，在系统设置中亲自允许当前App，再点“重新检查并开始”；系统要求重启时，退出并重开同一路径。
3. 点击“开始打字钢琴”启动持续全局会话，随后可回其他App打字。尚未授权时，可用“本窗口试弹（无需权限）”打字或点击琴键试听；本地模式失焦或关闭窗口会停止。
4. ♪菜单提供暂停、声音、App音量、画面、标签和退出。关闭控制台不会结束持续全局会话；测试子菜单的60秒模式会自动停止。不要把60秒测试误当日常持续模式。

**升级后的旧授权可能失效。** ad-hoc重建或重签会改变代码身份；相同Bundle ID、同一路径、系统条目仍显示开启，都不能保证新包已获授权。本机从旧签名升级时，单纯关闭再打开开关未刷新旧记录：需先退出App，在“隐私与安全性 → 输入监控”移除失效的旧条目，再添加最终路径的新App，由用户允许并重开。只处理本App的条目，不重置整个权限数据库。CLI的preflight结果不代替GUI建立全局监听及实按验证。

同Bundle重复启动会激活已有实例并退出新启动自身，不终止其他软件。旧 `local.typingpiano.probe` 探针不在此控制范围，应自行正常退出。

## 音量与音库

新偏好默认50%，完整音库对应mixer0.375；最大100%为0.75，sampler增益+12dB。已有偏好会继续加载。0%清尾并抑制新音，不停止输入/动画；调高不重播旧音。完整音库覆盖MIDI33—96；64音velocity127和弦的既有离线峰值约0.699767（约3.10dB余量），不代表所有设备、演奏序列或长期听感均已验证。Float32片段和90组测量见 [音频校准证据](../docs/evidence/C-002T/audio-calibration/)。

测试子菜单还保留原创合成64音和Kawai10音/Steinway11音候选。部分候选缺音保持无声；换库会停止旧监听和声音，需重新开始。当前完整音库为单层mono16试用资源，音色仍可调整。

## Dock与边界

GUI启动会默认启用**系统原生Dock自动隐藏**，不再使用模拟开关。关闭前提示与钢琴重叠风险；取消不写入。App仅恢复本会话拥有且仍可核对的改动：若启动时系统已为true，不会退出后恢复成更早的false；发现外部不同值时不覆盖。未决/崩溃恢复票据须明确处理。

原生后端通过 `dlsym` 检测HIServices的 `CoreDockGetAutoHideEnabled` / `CoreDockSetAutoHideEnabled`，只操作autohide。它们是**私有SPI**，本机实测即时生效不构成其他macOS版本的兼容保证。缺失、无效读回或写后核对失败会明确报错，可用菜单“系统Dock设置…”直接调整；没有defaults-only假成功、Dock重启、Apple Events或新增权限的自动回退。

钢琴自动使用目标屏幕完整宽度减16pt，左右各留8pt、底缘贴屏幕，高度保持104pt（56pt琴键＋48pt效果区）。默认仍选内置屏优先的一条钢琴，不跟随鼠标跨屏跳，日常不再选900/1000/1100宽度。

Dock显隐依据已配对验证的Dock专属layer20窗口及 `onScreenOnly` 成员关系，不用鼠标靠边热区代替。实际出现时260ms淡出；隐藏稳定120ms后360ms淡入，减少动态为80ms。短暂未知保持当前状态，连续未知2秒后恢复可见并保留未知诊断。隐藏只影响视觉，输入和声音继续；恢复当前按压状态，不补播旧音符。

当前菜单请求16pt槽宽、16×16pt模板画布，使用18pt的♪字形按实际墨迹边界缩放居中。本版真实菜单显示与点击尚待验收。此前0.2.4在本机已现场验证：实际20pt菜单按钮、1512pt屏幕上的1496×104浮层、原生Dock开关及淡变、本窗口试听、重新授权后的普通全局输入和琴声。真实Fn/Caps/双侧修饰的完整矩阵、中文/快捷键、声学延迟、设备切换、全屏/多屏组合和长时稳定性仍未全部验收。

`probe-preferences.json`（音量/标签）和 `dock-recovery.json`（有待恢复改动时）目前放在App同级；Caches构建目录可能被系统清理。升级应先正常退出，**只替换完整App，保留同级偏好**，再核对授权。不要在运行中覆盖App或为继续使用旧授权而重签现成包。

## 开发复现

需要macOS、提供Swift6.0或更新工具链的Xcode/Command Line Tools，以及Python3.9或更新版本。实际验证工具链为Swift6.4。构建脚本只用Python标准库；额外的 `verify_candidate_banks.py` 核验脚本才需要 `jsonschema`。构建依赖完整的 `Design/`、`contracts/`、`Code/Assets/` 和音频交接/manifest文件，不可只下载Code目录；manifest列出的源文件也须齐全。

在包含Code、Design、contracts的**仓库根目录**执行。以下每次创建独立候选目录，不依赖作者用户名或本机项目绝对路径，也不会覆盖正在使用的授权包：

```sh
mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/Caches/typing-piano-builds"
export TYPING_PIANO_BUILD_ROOT="$(mktemp -d "$HOME/Library/Caches/typing-piano-builds/candidate-0.2.5.XXXXXX")"
bash Code/Scripts/build.sh
codesign --verify --strict "$TYPING_PIANO_BUILD_ROOT/打字钢琴试用.app"
"$TYPING_PIANO_BUILD_ROOT/打字钢琴试用.app/Contents/MacOS/TypingPianoProbe" --self-check
"$TYPING_PIANO_BUILD_ROOT/打字钢琴试用.app/Contents/MacOS/TypingPianoProbe" --menu-smoke
```

输出为该目录下的 `打字钢琴试用.app` 和同名ZIP；脚本验证冻结资源哈希，进行本地ad-hoc签名并检查签名。上述自检不启键盘监听或硬件声音，菜单smoke不安装真实状态项。需要试用时再手动打开App；开始前留意其系统Dock默认开启行为。

未指定环境变量时，现有脚本默认输出到 `$HOME/Library/Caches/local.typingpiano.trial/candidate-0.2.5`。该默认目录重复构建会被更新，所以推荐上面的唯一目录命令。脚本明确拒绝输出到 `$HOME/Library/Caches/local.typingpiano.trial` 根目录，这是已有授权安装的保护规则，不是建议绕过的构建错误。已使用/授权的候选目录也不应再拿来构建。

可选的无窗口回归组（先完成上述构建环境变量设置）：

swift test --build-system native --package-path Code \

  --filter 'PianoCoreTests|NativeDockStorageTests|DockWindowVisibilityTests|AdaptiveOverlayTests|DockAdapterTests|SingleInstanceTests|RuntimeDiagnosticsTests|LocalTrialStartTests|AudioSelectionTests|MenuIntegrationTests|PianoMacTests.IntegrationTests'
